name: Birdie in the Snow
summary:
You play as Birdie, a soviet mech pilot. On the way to a mission, youre mech is critically damaged and you barrel into the snowy taigas of Russia. You find yourself stranded, and maybe not alone...

You must allocate your resources as necessary to ensure your survival from inside the cockpit. The winter forest is an unforgiving environment

Survive till dawn.
